extract: remote text document URL

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, UrlExtractionConfig, ExtractInputKind, UrlExtractionMode

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com")
    config = ExtractionConfig(url=UrlExtractionConfig(mode=UrlExtractionMode("document")))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].content)
    print(result.summary.remote_urls)

asyncio.run(main())
```
